recognize_zh: 一顆與紅血球大小相近的白血球，細胞內充滿粗大、深紫黑色的顆粒，顆粒多到把細胞核遮住、核輪廓幾乎看不清，這就是嗜鹼性球（basophil）。
features: Cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Cytoplasm packed with coarse, dark purple-black granules of variable size
Granules overlie and largely obscure an irregular, lobulated nucleus
Granules extend to and bulge the cell margin
Background of normocytic red cells and occasional platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single granulocyte slightly larger than surrounding red cells. The cytoplasm is filled with coarse, dark purple-black granules that overlie and obscure an irregular nucleus. Background red cells and platelets are unremarkable. Findings are consistent with a normal basophil.

ddx.vs: Mast cells are larger with a round central nucleus not obscured by granules and are found in tissue or marrow rather than peripheral blood.
Eosinophil granules are uniform, refractile and orange-pink with a clearly visible bilobed nucleus.
Toxic granules are fine and dark but sparse enough that the segmented nucleus remains clearly visible.
Platelet clumps show individual platelets with pale hyalomere at the edge rather than a single cell membrane containing granules.
